visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person in an orange sweatshirt sits in a brightly lit indoor space with white railings, their face completely obscured by a large yellow cartoon head sticker. They hold a microphone with a yellow 'HahaTai' sign, gesturing with their hands as they speak. (2) The scene cuts to an outdoor street at night where a host wearing a beige jacket, cap, and glasses stands before blurred city lights and passing cars, speaking energetically into a microphone. (3) Under the glow of artificial night lighting, the person in the orange sweatshirt uses a silver spray can to paint a stylized white cartoon face onto a weathered metallic sheet attached to a wall. (4) The camera provides a close-up of the graffiti process as purple spray paint is used to add the letters 'HA' next to the completed cartoon face on the metallic surface. (5) The final artwork is revealed, combining the white cartoon face and purple 'HAHA' text, while the host and the artist interact enthusiastically beside the wall in the dark urban setting.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote a collaboration between the 'HahaTai' media channel and the graffiti artist 'Dachangwang' (Jason). It uses an energetic interview format and a time-lapse-style demonstration of street art to engage the audience and highlight the creation of a 'joint-branded' cartoon character on a legal graffiti wall.
